name: Khalji Dynasty
events: Mongol invasion of India: Duwa Khan, Mongol ruler of the Chagatai Khanate, sends his sons Qutlugh Khwaja…
Indian forces under Sultan Alauddin Khalji capture Ranthambore Fortress.
General Malik Kafur arrives at Delhi and presents to Sultan Alauddin the treasures captured from Warrangal.
Sultan Alauddin Khalji of the Delhi Sultanate dies after a 19-year reign at Delhi.
